settings.title: New game.
settings.text: REF54 turns the QB54 chairs you already own into a brand-new target game. Nothing new to set up: cover the hole with the flap, fold the back fabric down so only the seat is left, and the chair becomes the target.
settings.image_alt: Friends in referee jerseys tossing REF54 flags at a QB54 chair target

settings.title: Introducing
settings.text:
Throw yellow flags, red flags and blue bean bags. Hit the target and claim your bragging rights.

Each team gets its own yellow flag, red flag and blue bean bag, so two teams can go head to head.
settings.image_alt: A yellow REF54 flag landing on the target

settings.title: It looks easy
settings.text:
A flag doesn't fly like a football. It flutters, drifts and lands wherever it wants, with everyone watching. That's what keeps people lining up for one more throw.

Grab REF54 and take your shot.
settings.image_alt: A player pointing at flags that landed on the REF54 target

settings.title: Two games.
settings.text: Play QB54, then turn a chair into the REF54 target. Same chairs, same backyard or tailgate, and another fun way to bring everyone together on game day.
settings.image_alt: QB54 goal posts and a REF54 target chair set up together at a tailgate

settings.title: Your QB54 fun
settings.text: REF54 celebrates the men and women who give their time to officiate football and every other sport. Throw the flag like the officials do and bring a fresh challenge to every gathering.
settings.image_alt: A yellow flag flying toward the REF54 target

settings.title: Set the target
settings.text: Use a QB54 chair: cover the hole with the flap and fold the back fabric down so only the seat is left.

settings.title: Throw the flags
settings.text: Each team throws its yellow flag, red flag and blue bean bag at the target.

settings.title: Claim bragging rights
settings.text: Hit the target and the bragging rights are yours.

settings.question: Do I need QB54 to play REF54?
settings.answer: REF54 uses a QB54 chair as its target: cover the hole with the flap and fold the back fabric down so only the seat is left. Don't have QB54 yet? Add a game set and REF54 together.

settings.question: What comes with REF54?
settings.answer: Each team gets 1 yellow flag, 1 red flag and 1 blue bean bag. The complete kit is pictured on this page and on the REF54 product page.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: Orders of $225 or more ship free. REF54 together with a QB54 game set gets you there.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: Returns are accepted within 30 days on unused items in their original packaging. See our return policy for full details.
